resultGroups.visualSourceNote: Pages containing the same or a modified version of the submitted image. This is image evidence, not an identity verdict.
resultGroups.visualSimilarityNote: Visually related public-web images. Similar appearance alone does not establish identity.
resultGroups.openSourceNote: Public web, news, publication, and authorized-source findings related to the search context.
resultGroups.crossSourceNote: The same public URL was independently returned by more than one search source. This strengthens source corroboration, not biometric identity certainty.
